# Mayank Pandey | Full Stack Developer

> Portfolio of Mayank Pandey, a Full Stack Developer building fast, scalable React, TypeScript and Node.js applications with clean code and user-focused design.

This site showcases Mayank Pandey's work, skills, freelance projects, and a sample Shopify store development proposal. Visitors can review case studies, schedule a meeting, or get in touch for collaboration.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, hero, and introduction to Mayank Pandey as a Full Stack Developer.
- [About](/#about): Background, experience, and approach to building software.
- [Skills](/#skills): Technical stack — JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, SQL, and more.
- [Projects](/#projects): Featured freelance and full stack development projects.
- [Hire Me](/#hire-me): Engagement options, availability, and how to start a project.
- [Schedule a Meeting](/#book): Book a 30-minute intro call directly.
- [Contact](/#contact): Email, phone, and social links.

## Optional
